'''Engar Ret''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. He commanded an [[Imperial scout base]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Tempay]], in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of [[Gacerian]], during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Ret coveted the position of Gacerian's [[Governor/Legends|Governor]], [[Ulbrek Gostech]], and followed his every move in order to report all failures to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].
